title: Graduate Program 2027 - Engineering
abstract: Join our 2027 Graduate Program and gain hands-on experience in engineering working alongside industry experts to build a rewarding career
bullets: Mentoring and learning from industry experts
Career pathways across Australia's leading home builders
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
content_text:
Build Your Future Career with NEX Building Group
Supaloc delivers high-performance steel framing systems which have shaped and transformed the dreams of Australian families for nearly 30 years. Our company culture is focussed on safety, innovation, and quality. We are the nation's largest supplier of precision-engineered steel framing systems and we provide 'end to end' solutions for new home construction across multiple states and have a strong emphasis on working with leading regional brands.
We are part of the NEX Building Group, an Australian network of more than 1300 passionate people who all share one purpose: to build beautiful homes for Australians
We are excited to offer Graduate opportunities within our 2027 Graduate Program, providing you with the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals, develop technical and leadership capabilities, and build a successful long-term career within our growing organisation. This opportunity is ideally suited to graduates with a passion for engineering
About the Program
Commencing February 2027, our structured 2-year Graduate Program provides exposure to multiple areas of the residential building industry through a series of rotations. You’ll be based in the office Monday to Friday.
Throughout the program, graduates will participate in:
•Soft skills and professional development workshops
•Keynote speaker sessions with industry and business leaders
•A collaborative graduate group project
•Leadership development opportunities
•Tours of Supaloc, MyChoice, display homes and key supplier locations
•Dedicated mentor and buddy support
Following successful completion of the program, graduates will transition into a permanent role within NEX Building Group.
About You
We're looking for enthusiastic graduates who:
•Graduated in 2025 or 2026
•Hold a degree in Construction Management, Building and design, Built Environment, Property Development, Project Management, Trade Qualification or related discipline. 
•Have strong communication and relationship-building skills
•Demonstrate initiative, curiosity and a willingness to learn
•Are passionate about building a long-term career in the residential construction industry
•Are willing to undertake occasional interstate travel as part of the Graduate Program
Why Join NEX Building Group?
At NEX Building Group, our people are at the centre of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, inclusive and innovative culture where graduates are empowered to contribute from day one.
You'll benefit from:
•A structured career development pathway
•Exposure to multiple areas of the business
•Senior leader mentoring and support
•Strong networking opportunities across our brands
•Ongoing learning and development programs
•A clear transition into a permanent role at the completion of the program
•Employee benefits: Discounts on gym membership, motor vehicle, health insurance and MORE!
What You'll Need to Apply
We want your application journey to be as smooth as possible, so here's what you'll need to prepare:
•Your CV and Academic Transcripts
•A Cover Letter: Tell us about yourself, why are you interested, your career aspirations and where you'd like to grow within the business.
Interested?
The appointment of successful applicants will be subject to satisfactory employment screening and, depending on the inherent requirements of the role, may involve the completion of a National Police Check and pre-employment medical.
Applications are now open, with offers expected to be extended by the end of November 2026.
If you are determined to build a long-term career and want to join an innovative and inclusive organisation committed to building better lives, click Apply Now.
To find out more about NEX Building Group, visit www.nexbg.com.au, follow us on LinkedIn, or contact our Talent Acquisition Team at careers@nexbg.com.au.
If you're ready to build your future with one of Australia's leading residential building groups, apply now and join our 2027 Graduate Program.
